concerns.text: FR-002 still reads 'scaffold-based split with [deferred] train, [deferred] validation, [deferred] test ratios'. This directly contradicts FR-013, which asserts fixed '80/10/10 split ratios', and violates Constitution Principle VI mandating 80/10/10. The ratios are a mandated constant, not an empirical value to defer. Restore explicit 80/10/10 in FR-002.

Scenario 3 still contains 'top-[deferred] highest FQY values of the test set'. The placeholder prevents reproducible instantiation of the test. Replace with a concrete selection rule (e.g., top-5% highest FQY values).

Internal inconsistency: FR-013 states the system 'does not alter the 80/10/10 split ratios' while FR-002 leaves the ratios as [deferred] placeholders. One of the two statements must be wrong; align both to the constitution-mandated 80/10/10.
